_doc: Real recorded room impulse responses for the engine's convolution reverb (build_ir.py). Nothing is generated or synthesised: every IR is a measurement of a real space (EchoThief, OpenAIR), trimmed (leading silence and the direct sound removed, `predelay_ms` records how long the first reflection comes after the direct sound), cut to max_s with a cosine fade, peak-normalised to -3 dBFS, 48 kHz stereo. A mono / ORTF-less source is paired from two real microphone positions of the same space (L = receiver 1, R = receiver 2), never duplicated. `src` entries are relative to C:\tb\audio-src\ir (a bare name = searched under the EchoThief library). rt60_s = Schroeder backward-integration T20 of the untrimmed recording. Licenses: EchoThief = derivative artistic use (convolution) allowed, not for AI training (Chris Warren, SDSU); OpenAIR = CC BY 4.0, University of York.
